description: A React component implementing an import modal dialog for uploading and importing models/files, with support for passwords, overwrite confirmation, and SSH tunnel credentials.

classes.name: ImportModal
classes.description: React functional component for importing models/files with password and SSH tunnel support.

methods.name: clearModal
methods.description: Resets modal state and clears input fields.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the modal and resets state.

methods.name: onUpload
methods.description: Handles file upload and triggers import process.

methods.name: changeFile
methods.description: Updates file list when a file is selected.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a selected file from the list.

methods.name: confirmOverwrite
methods.description: Checks user input for overwrite confirmation.

methods.name: renderPasswordFields
methods.description: Renders password and SSH credential input fields.
